city_center.name: Miami Beach Art Deco District (Ocean Drive / Collins Ave) + Downtown Orlando
city_center.landmark: South Beach Art Deco Historic District (900+ deco buildings); Orlando's Lake Eola and downtown farmers market inland
city_center.notes: Miami is the Cuban/Latin cultural anchor of the Southeast; Publix (Lakeland, FL headquarters) is the dominant home grocer statewide. Orlando is the Central Florida sister metro. sources: miamibeachfl.gov/architecture/art-deco; en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Miami_Beach_Architectural_District.

featured_frontier.hook: Cuban cafe con leche + Florida citrus over Power Cakes -- a South Beach pastel breakfast stack in peak winter citrus season
featured_frontier.photo_cue: pastel art-deco facade, chrome eyebrow overhangs, fresh orange + grapefruit segments, cafe con leche foam; Florida sunlight
featured_frontier.signature_ingredient: Florida citrus (oranges, grapefruit, tangerines Nov-May) + strawberries (Dec-Mar peak); Cuban coffee tie

cross_promo.partner: Local Florida farmers markets (Orlando Farmers Market at Lake Eola; South Florida markets)
cross_promo.activation: Florida citrus + Cuban-coffee glaze recipe card, Publix retailer lockup

audience: Latin-influenced Miami families + Central Florida households; Publix-first Florida shoppers, bilingual Spanish/English homes

cultural_notes: Miami is the Cuban and broader Latin-American cultural capital of the Southeast; cafe con leche, pastelitos, and Little Havana anchor the daily-life food culture (source: general regional cultural knowledge; language selection flagged INFERRED)

South Beach holds an unrivaled concentration of Art Deco architecture -- over 900 buildings in the Miami Beach Architectural District, with the pastel palette standardized by a 1980s preservation campaign (source: miamibeachfl.gov/architecture/art-deco; corcoran.com inhabit; audiala.com South Beach guide)

Florida's agricultural calendar is near-tropical and inverted from the north: the state's most intense growing season runs October through May, making winter -- not summer -- peak citrus and strawberry season (source: fdacs.gov Crops-in-Season; sarasotamagazine.com; UF/IFAS blogs.ifas.ufl.edu)
Publix is a Florida institution (Lakeland headquarters) and the dominant home grocer across the state (source: Publix regional footprint)
